takeaway: False: the LCA does not supply the AV node in most cases; the RCA does in 90%. The LCA supplies most of the left ventricle and atrium, part of the right ventricle, and the SA node in 40%.

lines.text: A patient has a blocked left coronary artery. Which statement about this artery is false?
Here is the left coronary artery.
The left coronary artery supplies the vast majority of the left ventricle,
and of the left atrium too.
Through a conus branch, it also supplies part of the right ventricle.
It supplies the sinoatrial node in 40% of hearts; the right coronary artery does in 60%.
lines.say: It supplies the sinoatrial node in forty percent of hearts; the right coronary artery does in sixty percent.

lines.text: But the right coronary artery supplies the atrioventricular node in 90% of cases; saying the left supplies it in most cases is false.
lines.say: (clears throat) But the right coronary artery supplies the atrioventricular node in ninety percent of cases; saying the left supplies it in most cases is false.
